items.title: Roscoe Mitchell interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 23, 2023
items.q: Ornette Coleman’s record is a monster you know, him and Don Cherry and Charlie Haden, Ed Blackwell. That is some stellar music.

ctx.x: Do you think that Ornette Coleman’s LP back in ’61 was an unfortunate —
It was a monster. It was a monster. Ornette Coleman’s record is a monster you know, him and Don Cherry and Charlie Haden, Ed Blackwell. That is some stellar music.
But did he call it free jazz do you know?
